scenario_description: The sandboxed runtime still rejects a component that exits zero with invalid JSON shape.
expected: The source and adapter pass before the deliberately broken sink runs.
The sink exits zero but both exact schema errors are retained and the runtime remains incomplete.
Network preflight and exact container cleanup still pass on the failed workload.

The sink exited zero but validation retained missing /report/title and /trace/source and kept the runtime incomplete.

notes: PASS means the verifier detected the deliberate green-exit invalid artifact; the broken pipeline itself failed as designed.
